items.name: chain-selector
items.title: Chain Selector
items.description: Network switcher for wagmi apps, as a popover (ChainSelector) or dialog (ChainSelectorDialog). Shows the current chain with its icon, lists every chain in the wagmi config (optionally grouped into mainnet/testnet tabs), marks the active chain, shows a per-row spinner while switching, and surfaces wallet errors inline; a rejected request shows as cancelled, not as an error. Wraps useSwitchChain, useChains and useChainId. Icon slots are swappable or can be hidden; iconOnly mode keeps an accessible label.

items.name: wagmi-config
items.title: wagmi config + provider
items.description: Starter wagmi setup: lib/wagmi-config.ts (mainnet + sepolia, injected connector, SSR on) and a Web3Provider component that wraps WagmiProvider and a TanStack QueryClientProvider. Install once, wrap your app in <Web3Provider>, then add any 0xui component.

items.name: 0xui-utils
items.title: 0xui utils
items.description: Shared web3 formatting helpers used by 0xui components: truncateAddress (checksummed 0x1234…abcd), formatTokenAmount (bigint + decimals to a locale string without float precision loss, rounds toward zero, compact notation, '<0.0001' for dust), parseAmount (lenient user input to bigint: '.5', '1,000.5', '1.000,5', clamps to token decimals), getExplorerUrl (address/tx/block links from chain.blockExplorers) and isUserRejection (detects a dismissed wallet prompt).

items.name: use-mounted
items.title: useMounted
items.description: SSR guard hook: false during server render and hydration, true afterwards. Keeps browser-only wallet state out of server HTML to avoid hydration mismatches. Built on useSyncExternalStore, so there is no extra render on client-only apps.

items.name: use-copy
items.title: useCopy
items.description: Clipboard hook: copy(text) writes to the clipboard and sets copied=true for a configurable timeout. Resolves false when clipboard access is unavailable or denied.
